name: Wayfarer Shuttle
description: A stubby, honest hull that has carried more first-time captains than anyone has counted. It does a little of everything and nothing in a hurry.

name: Swiftwing Courier
description: Built to beat the post, with a long-legged tank and a hold just big enough for sealed bags. Captains swear it leans into turns on its own.

name: Pathfinder Scout
description: A thin, nimble hull with fuel for the longest empty stretches of the rim. There is barely room for a bunk, let alone a crate.

name: Mule Light Freighter
description: A plain box with an engine strapped to it, and the cheapest tonnage on the lanes. It is slow, sturdy and forgiving of poor flying.

name: Kestrel Interceptor
description: The fastest hull the Concord yards turn out, all engine and very little hold. It answers the stick before you finish thinking.

name: Starlit Liner
description: Rows of lit cabins along a gentle spine, made for moving people in comfort. Cargo rides in whatever space the passengers leave.

name: Ironback Heavy Freighter
description: A slab-sided hauler that Free Reach crews load until the hull groans. It turns like a barn door and carries like a mountain.

name: Warden Corvette
description: A sharp-nosed patrol hull with thick plating and generous bays for fittings. It is tough for its size and handsome besides.

name: Meridian Trader
description: A well-rounded merchant flagship, with a big hold, good berths and reach to spare. Prosperous captains settle on it and stay.

name: Bastion Carrier
description: A vast, deliberate hull that hauls and shelters more than any other ship in the lanes. It takes its time, and nothing much bothers it.

name: Patience-class Surveyor
description: A one-off survey hull, patiently restored from a drifting wreck. Her long-legged tank and built-in chart table let a captain see two jumps beyond any arrival.
